from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class FinancialMetric(BaseModel):
    """A single financial data point extracted from one document."""
    company: str | None = Field(description="The company name as stated in the document")
    fiscal_year: str | None = Field(description="The fiscal year the data point belongs to (e.g., '2020')")
    metric_label: str | None = Field(description="The exact line item label for the value")
    amount: float | None = Field(description="The numeric value of the metric")
    quote: str = Field(description="Verbatim excerpt anchoring the value")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    financial_metrics: list[FinancialMetric]
